event.description: Preserve digit rows and merge only the two control-token embeddings
event.proposal: Family: token representation. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 9 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0016 at 3,376 parameters/99.18%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0114, whose Chebyshev digit basis scored 28.80% at 1,663 parameters. Hypothesis: attempt-0114 failed because it projected the ten digit classifier rows, while the BOS and equals controls—which are never target outputs—can share one input feature. Use ten one-hot digit features plus one shared control feature and fit the 11x16 projection by least squares; this preserves every digit row exactly and averages only control rows, yielding 1,663 parameters. This is more informative than another polynomial digit basis because it isolates control-token identity without altering digit geometry at the same count.
